Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::generateLoanAgreement(): Boolean {
	definition:
		loanAgreement: LoanAgreement
	precondition:
		CurrentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		loanAgreement.oclIsNew() and
		LoanAgreement.allInstance()->includes(loanAgreement) and
		loanAgreement.Content = "Loan Agreement" and
		CurrentLoanRequest.AttachedLoanAgreement = loanAgreement and
		result = true
}
